identity.title: Deterministic Reconnect Synchronization in Market WebSocket Tests
identity.objective: Remove runner-speed dependence from the four WP169 Market WebSocket reconnect tests in tests/data_layer/polymarket/test_market_truth_websocket.py (test_reconnect_uses_current_subscription_set_not_original, test_normal_book_gaps_are_persisted_and_healed, test_continuity_fault_triggers_reconnect_wait, test_non_store_limit_failed_append_reconnects_not_silently_continues). Each fixed wall-clock sleep that assumed the real 1-second reconnect backoff had elapsed is replaced by condition-driven synchronization on the observable condition itself (second-connection subscription payload emitted, HEALED gap evidence persisted, reconnect socket #2 opened), each bounded by a generous finite timeout that stops the runner and fails clearly instead of hanging. The real product backoff and all assertions are preserved. Tests-only: no change under src/, no _BACKOFF_SCHEDULE change, no backoff/sleeper injection API, no dependency, workflow, network, credential, strategy, paper, execution or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-TEST-WS-01. The four WP169 reconnect tests return to their prior fixed wall-clock sleeps and the S10-TEST-WS-01 status/spec artifacts and bounded status-transition edits disappear. No product/runtime code, backoff schedule, dependency, workflow, store, evidence, order or capital state is touched by this WP.

api_matrix.reason: Tests-only synchronization repair; no public or private product API is added, changed or injected (no backoff/sleeper parameter).

semantic_fields.reason: These rules close which observable condition each repaired reconnect test awaits, the bounded-failure discipline and preservation of the real product backoff.

items.required_rule: test_reconnect_uses_current_subscription_set_not_original awaits the first connection's initial payload, then all three dynamic subscription updates sent on socket #1, then the reconnect subscription payload actually emitted on socket #2 (sockets[1].sent non-empty) before stop; socket creation alone is insufficient.
items.validation_rule: No fixed sleep remains as a synchronization condition; the sockets[1].sent[0] assertions are unchanged.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: test_normal_book_gaps_are_persisted_and_healed awaits the durable OPEN TIMESTAMP_REGRESSION gap row before queueing the fresh book, then awaits the HEALED gap row itself before stop.
items.validation_rule: The success condition is persisted HEALED gap evidence, never elapsed wall-clock time; the exact OPEN reason and healed>=1 assertions are unchanged.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: test_continuity_fault_triggers_reconnect_wait and test_non_store_limit_failed_append_reconnects_not_silently_continues await a bounded asyncio.Event set by the connection factory when reconnect socket #2 is created (the continuity test also awaits socket #1 before feeding frames).
items.validation_rule: The len(sockets) >= 2 and STORAGE_FAILURE assertions are unchanged.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Every synchronization wait uses a finite 30-second timeout; on timeout it sets stop, awaits the runner with the same bound and calls pytest.fail naming the missing condition.
items.validation_rule: A regression that prevents reconnect yields a clear pytest failure within the bound and never hangs.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: The real product reconnect backoff (_BACKOFF_SCHEDULE[0] == 1s) is exercised unchanged; nothing under src/ changes and no injection API is added.
items.validation_rule: The exact-scope diff shows zero src/ paths; the tests still wait the real backoff.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure
